ADVENTCALENDAR_EVENT: Login everyday and collect your daily reward from Advent Calendar, if you will meet the minimum required days you will be able to get FINAL REWARD!
BEGINNER_EVENT: During the event, all players will receive special items that will help them advance much faster in their adventure to become a HERO. The received package contains very valuable and unique items.
BLACK_JACK_EVENT: Blackjack is an event where you have to get Tokens from the metin stones, with 100 of them you can play a round by RIGHT Clicking on the token.
BOSS_POWER_EVENT: During the event, all players will have a bonus +20% Strong vs. Bosses.
CALENDAR_OKEY_EVENT: During the event Okey Collectable Cards drop from stones. When x150 Okey Cards are stacked, they become an Okey Card Set, play with them and collect one of 3 valuable chests full of surprises.
COLLECT_LETTERS_EVENT: Form the word "RODNIA2" with letters you get from stones and monsters close to your level and you will receive valuable rewards.
COMBAT_ZONE_EVENT: PvP Fight Every man for himself with amazing Prizes and Points for our Battlezone shop.
COMEBACK_EVENT: Returning players receive Comeback Chest as WelcomeBack gift (14 days not logged in requirement).
DESTINYSWHEEL_EVENT: During the event collect Destiny Wheel Tickets from stones and bosses and spin the wheel and be rewarded.
DOJANG35_CLASIC_EVENT: Each race will fight in an arena, until the last one is standing. - for Lv. 35 Players
DOJANG35_UNIVERSAL_EVENT: All races will fight for Supremacy in the Arena, until the last one is standing. - for Lv. 35 Players
DOJANG75_CLASIC_EVENT: Each race will fight in an arena, until the last one is standing. - for Lv. 75 Players
DOJANG75_UNIVERSAL_EVENT: All races will fight for Supremacy in the Arena, until the last one is standing. - for Lv. 75 Players
DOJANG_CLASIC_EVENT: Each race will fight in an arena, until the last one is standing.
DOJANG_UNIVERSAL_EVENT: All races will fight for Supremacy in the Arena, until the last one is standing.
DOUBLE_BOSS_SPAWN_EVENT: All bosses from maps will be doubled during the event.
DOUBLE_DROP_BOSS_EVENT: The whole loots from the bosses will now be double, except Boss Scrolls.
DOUBLE_DROP_FISHING_EVENT: Catch double the amount of fish during this event.
DOUBLE_DROP_STONE_EVENT: The whole loots from the stones will now be double, except Salvation Stones.
DOUBLE_STONE_SPAWN_EVENT: All stones from maps will be doubled during the event.
DUNGEON_COOLDOWN_EVENT: Cooldown for all dungeons will be decreased with a certain percent.
DUNGEON_PASS_DISCOUNT_EVENT: All Passes from Dungeon Shop will have a discount during the event.
DUNGEON_PASS_EVENT: You have a chance to get the pass back after completing the Dungeon from the Final Dungeon Boss.
ELF_HUNT_EVENT: Elves have appeared in Sohan Mountain, look for them, capture them and they will give you rewards.
ENCHANT_EVENT: During the event you can get between 61-65% Average Damage on weapon. Instant Switchbot will not work during the event.
FESTIVE_CHEST_EVENT: Obtain Festive Chest from our Seasonal Event fully with special rewards.
FOX_HUNT_EVENT: The Fox has appeared in Yongi Desert, find it, capture it and it will offer you a good reward as a reward. Rewards are Voucher RCs!
GOLDEN_FROG_EVENT: Many Golden Frogs will spawn in the special map, sharpen your weapon and prepare to destroy them to receive valuable rewards.
GUILD_WARS_EVENT: Takes place in special map with Conditions Winner Guild, show that your guild is the strongest, fearless and ready for battle, and the rewards will be worth it.
JIGSAW_EVENT: Catch fish and get the Jigsaw Chest, complete the puzzle and you will be rewarded with the Goldfish Chest with lots of surprises inside.
MAGIC_CHEST_EVENT: Obtain Magic Chest from monsters and Magic Key from Bosses and unlock valuable items from the chest.
OX_EVENT: True or False? Are you ready to try your luck? Arena OX is waiting for you, be the only one in the Arena with the correct answers and you will be rewarded at the end.
PVM_EVENT: In a special map, a lot of fierce bosses will appear, defeat them and you will receive valuable Tiger Coins. Right Click on Coin to open the Shop.
PVP_EVENT: Kingdom War it's a battle of conquest, collect the flags, score points with them and prove that you are strong, the entire Kingdom will be rewarded with 20% bosses/stones for 2 day.
KINGDOM_WAR_FLAG_EVENT: Is a competition event where the bravest members of each realm will confront each other in an epic battle for glory and triumph.Capture the opponent`s flag and move it back to the own base to score a point.
RANDOM_WORD_EVENT: The random word will appear in-game Chat, be the first to spell it correctly and you will receive the prize for your quick skill.
SANTAS_LOOT_EVENT: Santa's gift is hidden in the farm maps, find it first to open the chest full of amazing prizes.
SEASONAL_EVENT: Special Event for Special Holidays specific thematic, check the Special NPC near Uriel to craft various items to farm and increase your evolution more easily.
STONE_POWER_EVENT: During the event, all players will have a bonus +20% Strong vs. Stones.
SYMBOL_EVENT: Form the word "RODNIA2" with symbols you get from Bosses and monsters close to your level and you will receive valuable rewards.
TANAKA_EVENT: Catch and Kill Tanaka Pirate, collect the most quivers, their quiver contains very valuable things.
WORLDCUP_EVENT: Drop Football from Metins, Monsters and Dungeons with amazing prizes, also check the NPC near Uriel to make your goals stand out.
HYPERBOOST_EVENT: The Hyper Boost Event introduces new dungeons, valuable rewards, and gameplay upgrades to help you progress faster and dominate every challenge.
SPIN_WHEEL_EVENT: Destroy a certain number of stones to fill the progress bar and spin the wheel for a prize. Rewards are based on level ranges.
SECRET_MAPS_EVENT: During the event, you will obtain shards in maps, at 50 you will receive a pass for a secret map, which will be special metins with 1.5x Drop, you will be able to farm for 20 minutes! Hurry!
